Honestly, I don't even know where to start.

I was always a husky boy, and had a propensity for sweets, so between the genetics and the bad eating habits, I've never exactly been skinny. Now middle-aged, I've got several decades worth of those bad habits to fight off. I'm no stranger to the gym and to proper diets. In my prime, I was probably in the best shape of my life, even if it didn't physically look like it. I had cut a lot of the fat, and dramatically improved my strength and endurance. I was able to meet military requirements (though I never served, it seemed like a great benchmark to measure against), and actually felt pretty good about myself.

Part of me is dealing with some really bad body image issues. I have gynocomastia, love-handles, and generally never feel attractive. Even when I was in my best shape, I still had the moobs, and there is nothing more demoralizing than that. I have a family that, while generally supportive of me, is not at all emotionally connected or "there for me." It's not uncommon to receive passive-aggressive comments about what I eat, or going to the gym more, or how I look.

Mind you, I'm not an ugly guy! I think I clean up well. I have a loving wife and her very loving family, but I don't know, I just feel like I'm stuck in this body, and that unless I throw a ridiculous amount of money into surgery that I'll never look the way I feel I should look. I know that is unhealthy, but I just can't seem to get past that hurdle. Sure, the usual rhetoric will tell me to do it for myself, and not for others, and to not care what others think...But it's not that easy.

I'm back at the gym, and I'm slowly making strides to overcome poor endurance and slow jogging times and limited lifting. All my food has been logged into online calculators, and I know to my own detriment I've been shaving significant amounts of calories off my daily intake which also isn't healthy. I just can't seem to find my equilibrium. I ate clean for three weeks and didn't shed a single pound. I cut my calories in half and still didn't lose any weight - and in fact somehow gained a pound (no, it wasn't from muscle gain, I've been doing cardio the past two weeks). I feel like I'm stuck, and I can't seem to break out mentally or physically.

So, I don't know, Fitness. Maybe I just needed to vent. Maybe I do need friendly advice. Maybe I need more help than I can reasonably expect to get from an anonymous group of folks. I just don't know what to do.
